title: One Hamming group and a retuned shortened tail in 235 operations

claims.statement: For the fixed length-2000 dimension-1000 code in proof.md consisting of 64 Hamming lanes, twenty-two systematic length-64 words with the stated parity order, and the marked shortened tail, the stated shared-table decoder has average block error on the memoryless BSC(1/10) with uniform messages at most the exact rational B below.
For the same code and shared-table decoder in proof.md, the bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=235 operations on every received word, with W <= 2^(196913/25000).

experiments.purpose: Verify the exact minimum-weight syndrome histograms and shared-bank exclusions in all four wide sectors. Sector zero also checks the shortened histogram and absent keys, Hamming probabilities, exact score inequalities, and fixed schedule with exact sample traces.
